notes.title: Demo 1.2 Update: New Save System!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022759/a961cf2a5afd570f72e86f4fa0023035c5943df5.png

Hey everyone,

I’ve received a lot of great suggestions for the game, and many of them were about the save system—something I had been wanting to refine as well.

Previously, the game allowed you to save almost anytime, but I realized this didn’t really serve the core experience I wanted to create. To introduce more layers of risk management, I’ve made some changes.

From now on, there are three ways to save your progress:


 Manual Save: Requires one *Ink Bottle*. You start with five and can buy more for four coins each.
 Resting: Save by setting up camp or staying at an inn.
 Prayer: Save by praying at an altar of the Ascendent or the Queen. The demo includes only one altar, but the full game will feature several across the map. However, if you’ve turned your back on the Sacred Family, don’t expect their blessings.


The game will also autosave at key points.

Other Changes


 Fixed a bug where spells could be cast from dialogue options without being trained in the magic circle.
 Item descriptions are now visible while buying and selling backpack items.
 Overwriting a save now correctly updates the save file name.
 Fixed the camping bug—setting up camp now works as intended.
 Camping now requires a bedroll in your backpack.
 Slightly increased combat difficulty.

Thank you to everyone who shared their ideas with me! More improvements are on the way!

notes.title: Demo Ver 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Thank you very much for playing the demo and sharing your feedback! Your support means a lot.

Here’s what’s new in this version:

- Fixed an issue where the “Finish” button in the character creation screen would load the next scene multiple times.
- Added more explanations for attributes and their effects in the character creation screen.
- Fixed various grammar and spelling errors.
- Removed Spellbook of Summon Lockpick and Spellbook of Light from character creation.
- Even more grammar and spelling fixes.
- Added tooltips in Mountain Pass and Fork to better explain dice rolls, combat mechanics, and backpack items. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022759/e13457fa3cf2fb9065e7709692ff0f0d902bbe93.jpg

More updates are on the way!

In the meantime, serve your Queen and enjoy your journey through The Mists.
